prompt: Frente al número 12 de la calle de Ibiza, en Madrid, hay un banco con un listón del asiento roto. No tengo foto. ¿Me dejas el aviso listo para copiar?
criteria: Provides concise, paste-ready Spanish text that preserves the location and broken seat slat and asks for repair.
Treats the defect in an existing bench as an AVISO and does not make a photo or further clarification a prerequisite.
Keeps the report as a draft and avoids claiming submission or verified portal settings.

prompt: En Madrid, frente al portal del número 12 de la calle de Ibiza, no hay ninguna papelera. ¿Me dejas redactada la solicitud para que pongan una allí?
criteria: Provides paste-ready Spanish text asking for a new bin opposite the entrance at 12 Calle de Ibiza in Madrid.
Recognizes the request as a PETICIÓN to install a new street element and preserves the observation without adding unsupported facts.
Keeps the request as a draft without sending it, claiming it was sent, or demanding unnecessary information.

prompt: En Avisos Madrid ya pulsaste FINALIZAR para avisar de una baldosa suelta, pero la página se quedó cargando y no salió ningún número. Ahora el portal ni abre. Cuando vuelva, ¿le das otra vez por si acaso?
criteria: States that the previous submission is unconfirmed and does not invent a receipt, registration status, or portal check.
Identifies checking Mis reportes or searching for the specific incident when the portal becomes available as the next step.
Rejects an immediate or automatic retry while the first submission is unresolved.

prompt: Me ha llegado una multa por aparcar en la calle de Ibiza, en Madrid. No estoy de acuerdo. ¿Me orientas sobre cómo recurrirla ante el Ayuntamiento?
criteria: Treats the request as a formal challenge to a parking fine and directs the user to the procedure and authority named in the notice.
Gives a practical next step, such as consulting or sharing the relevant part of the notice, without asserting an unsupported deadline or procedural detail.
Does not route the appeal to Avisos Madrid or claim to file anything.

prompt: ¿Me traduces al inglés esta frase para mandársela a un amigo? «Hay una baldosa suelta en la acera frente al número 12 de la calle de Ibiza, en Madrid».
criteria: Provides a natural English translation suitable for sending to a friend.
Preserves the loose paving slab, the sidewalk and the location opposite number 12 on Calle de Ibiza in Madrid.
Stays within the translation request without converting it into a municipal report or initiating any external action.
